integrity: Analytic full-frequency proof with explicit uniform tail bounds; companion finite checker supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: Unit-spaced translates of real polynomial-Gaussian first-degree mixtures only; no full Gabor bounds, no higher polynomial degrees. An equivalent older theta-function theorem remains a residual novelty risk.
title: Sharp three-transition Riesz spectra for integer translates of Gaussian–first-Hermite mixtures
